summary: Zentek Ltd., a Canadian graphene-technology company listed on TSXV/OTCQX, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) attaching an October 1, 2026 news release announcing shipment of its first ZenGUARD Enhanced Air Filters order under a Government of Canada standing offer dated August 20, 2026, covering National Capital Region HVAC filtration with a maximum published value of CAD 348,666.84 through August 18, 2027. No minimum volumes are guaranteed. This is an ordinary commercial/product announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor apply. Watch execution risk and the absence of binding purchase commitments.
